scope: Section12.10 proves smooth local Hessian-capacity convergence and canonical quasicontinuity, coefficient domination below degree m, and simultaneous decreasing convergence and symmetry of the ordered bounded Hessian currents through degree m. The proof retains all Hermitian torsion derivatives and uses smooth energy variations, boundary localization and finite polarization. Raw top-degree currents are distributional; their positive shifted wedges are Radon measures. Additional decreasing weights are proved only below degree m.
